original.statement: In the external-secrets.io/v1alpha1 schema of pushsecrets.external-secrets.io, the value "v1" was removed from the allowed values of spec.template.engineVersion, and a resource using that removed value is rejected by the API server.

decision.reason: The computed CRD diff between the v0.15.0 and v0.16.0 bundles [ev-9889c9b8706d, ev-e08924afdc47] shows "v1" removed from the enum for spec.template.engineVersion in the external-secrets.io/v1alpha1 PushSecret schema, with no values added. A removed value is rejected by the API server. The only exposed resources are therefore PushSecrets whose field equals "v1". The generic "field set" rule would also flag resources using values that are still allowed, so the narrower equals-"v1" condition is the exact exposure.
